about: Files old trillion deleted from 2026-10-10 on with no home and no backlog row, moved here byte for byte from the parent of the commit that deleted each (commit; deleted_by names the deleting commit). Nothing here is rewritten: a file waits here for its wiring, under its old path, so the files keep importing each other as they did. A redaction replaces a real person's name or address with a made-up one, and is listed on the file; source_identity is the BLAKE3 identity of the bytes at commit, identity of the bytes here.
